svg.desc: Serving design. Nightly batch: all ratings are used to fit the selected model and write a bundle with the top 200 candidates per user, item neighbours, recent popularity and the model version. Per request: validate, choose the model's list or the popularity fallback for cold users, merge recent items with reciprocal-rank fusion, drop rated and excluded movies, and return the top k with the strategy and model version.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Serving: precompute nightly, merge and filter per request

svg.text: The request path never fits a model; it reads the bundle and always reports its strategy.
